title: Om Galaxy IPO Details
intro:
Om Galaxy IPO is a book build issue of ₹105.00 crores. The issue is entirely a fresh issue of 1.17 crore shares of ₹105.00 crore.

Om Galaxy IPO bidding opened for subscription on Sep 10, 2026 and will close on Sep 15, 2026. The allotment for the Om Galaxy IPO is expected to be finalized on Sep 16, 2026. Om Galaxy IPO will list on the BSE SME with a tentative listing date fixed as Sep 18, 2026.

Om Galaxy IPO is set issue price band at ₹85 to ₹90 per share. The lot size for an application is 1,600 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹2,88,000 (3,200 shares) (based on upper price). The minimum lot size for investment in HNI is 3 lots (4,800 shares), amounting to ₹4,32,000.

Indorient Financial Services Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Bigshare Services Pvt.Ltd. is the registrar of the issue. The Market Maker of the company is Aikyam Capital Pvt.Ltd.

Refer to Om Galaxy IPO RHP for detailed Information.

faqs.question: How to apply in Om Galaxy IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in Om Galaxy IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Om Galaxy IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in Om Galaxy IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' Om Galaxy IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

faqs.question: When Om Galaxy IPO will open?
faqs.answer: The Om Galaxy IPO opens on Thu, Sep 10, 2026 and closes on Tue, Sep 15, 2026.

faqs.question: What is the lot size of Om Galaxy IPO?
faqs.answer: Om Galaxy IPO lot size is 1600 , and the minimum amount required for application is ₹2,88,000 , with 2 lots being the minimum application size .

faqs.question: How to apply for Om Galaxy IPO?
faqs.answer: You can apply in Om Galaxy IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha , Upstox , 5Paisa , Nuvama , HDFC Bank , and SBI Bank .

faqs.question: When is Om Galaxy IPO allotment?
faqs.answer: The finalization of Basis of Allotment for Om Galaxy IPO will be done on Wednesday, September 16, 2026 , and the allotted shares will be credited to your demat account by Thu, Sep 17, 2026 . Check the Om Galaxy IPO allotment status .

faqs.question: When is Om Galaxy IPO listing date ?
faqs.answer: The Om Galaxy IPO listing date is not yet announced. The tentative date of listing is Fri, Sep 18, 2026 .
